title: Machine learning predicts 72-hour mortality in polytrauma patients
summary: Random forest, neural network and XGBoost models were derived on a Dryad polytrauma database and externally validated on patients from the authors' institution. The random forest had an internal AUROC of 0.87 (95% CI 0.84-0.89) and an external AUROC of 0.98 (0.97-0.99), with SHAP and LIME explanations. The much higher external AUROC suggests different case mix, and the data are retrospective.
ai_technology: Random forest (compared with a neural network and XGBoost), explained with SHAP and LIME

evidence.tested: Internal validation on the Dryad dataset and an external cohort from the authors' institution.
evidence.unknown: Why external performance exceeds internal and multi-center generalization; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts 72-hour mortality from age, BMI, GCS, ISS, pH, base excess and lactate.
